epochs.genesis_note: Genesis epoch. Chain begins at the registry state current on 2026-07-18, deposit #1092 (AXN:0455.ARCHIVAL, gw.tachyon session tether). Prior history is preserved in git (leesharks000/alexanarch) and in the reconciliation record; this ledger formalizes forward-chaining from here. A later deletion cannot erase the evidence that these objects and their metadata were present at this epoch.
epochs.signature_note: Operator signing key not yet published; epochs are presently authenticated by git commit history and by cross-custody of this file in mirrors. Key publication is a spec v0.2 item.
